decision_question: Is the system boundary sufficiently defined?
proposed_exercise_position: Keep GOV-001 limited to extraction and recruiter queue prioritization; autonomous rejection is out of scope
decision_owner_role: Business sponsor and AI governance lead

decision_question: Can the case proceed with no named owner?
proposed_exercise_position: No; retain owner as unknown and treat accountability evidence as a blocking gap
required_evidence: Named accountable owner and approval record

decision_question: Can ranking be treated as low impact because a human makes the final decision?
proposed_exercise_position: No; assess practical influence on employment opportunity and reviewer behavior
decision_owner_role: AI governance lead and HR process owner

decision_question: Can applicant data be used before purpose and retention are defined?
proposed_exercise_position: No; require documented purpose minimization access retention and deletion requirements
required_evidence: Data inventory and approved retention/deletion design

decision_question: Can a model be accepted without representative evaluation?
proposed_exercise_position: No; require pre-registered criteria appropriate cohort analysis and error adjudication
required_evidence: Versioned dataset rubric raw outputs and scored report

decision_question: Does nominal recruiter sign-off establish meaningful oversight?
proposed_exercise_position: No; require source inspection correction override and escalation capability
required_evidence: Observed workflow and reviewer test evidence

decision_question: Can the workflow proceed without access tests and incident exercise?
proposed_exercise_position: No; require least-privilege evidence security testing and incident response exercise
required_evidence: Threat model access test traces and tabletop record

decision_question: Can a model or job-criteria update inherit prior approval automatically?
proposed_exercise_position: No; require materiality review and revalidation where the change may affect risk or performance
decision_owner_role: Model/system owner and AI governance lead

decision_question: Can the current evidence support deployment approval?
proposed_exercise_position: No; the case remains a design exercise with unresolved implementation and effectiveness evidence
required_evidence: Closure evidence for all critical findings
